details: Short-term confidence in the cryptocurrency market has seen a notable decline, with the Fear & Greed Index moving closer to the "fear" zone. This shift is largely attributed to a growing sense of caution driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and upcoming central bank decisions, particularly the Federal Reserve's expected maintenance of stable interest rates. This cautious environment is reducing risk appetite for cryptocurrencies, suggesting a period of continued indecision or potential weakness in the market.
title: Crypto Market Optimism Fades Amid Geopolitical & Central Bank Focus

details: Bitcoin has climbed 2% over the past 24 hours, surpassing $79,000, while Ethereum also recorded gains. This upward movement comes as subdued geopolitical tensions contribute to an easing of risk-off sentiment in global markets. Moreover, Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) in the U.S. continue to demonstrate strong demand, attracting $823.7 million in weekly inflows, marking their fourth consecutive week of positive flows. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has also improved, reaching 47 and moving into the "Neutral" zone from a previous "Fear" state.
title: Bitcoin Rises Above $79K Amid Subdued Geopolitical Tensions

details: MicroStrategy, a prominent institutional holder of Bitcoin, has expanded its cryptocurrency reserves by acquiring an additional 3,273 Bitcoin. This latest purchase, made between April 20-26, 2026, cost approximately $255 million. The continuous accumulation of Bitcoin by major corporate entities like MicroStrategy underscores ongoing institutional confidence in the digital asset as a long-term strategic investment, even amidst fluctuating market conditions and broader macroeconomic uncertainties.
title: MicroStrategy Adds 3,273 Bitcoin for $255 Million
